scope: Additive shared-adapter compatibility proof. Existing case identities and all family behavior obligations remain with their owners; this map does not consolidate or claim to execute those families.

cases.purpose: Authoritative mutable cold visibility; exact binary framing; no per-command processes; stale/missing/duplicate/unknown handoffs refuse; bounded ownership/cleanup; genuine child bytes/status/coverage.
cases.negative_controls: See each named case: omitted handoff/effect, stale token/state, wrong request identity, unknown commands, dropped bootstrap or missing active coverage evidence.

cases.purpose: Direct independent memory setup; production prepare/worktree identity; finite preflight with missing-observation control; real writer ready/release/liveness.
cases.negative_controls: See each named case: omitted handoff/effect, stale token/state, wrong request identity, unknown commands, dropped bootstrap or missing active coverage evidence.

cases.purpose: Independent file/mode/index/ignore/config/copy state; exact shared result transport; unknown/omitted command control.
cases.negative_controls: See each named case: omitted handoff/effect, stale token/state, wrong request identity, unknown commands, dropped bootstrap or missing active coverage evidence.

cases.purpose: Production worktree/report schema; genuinely reaped PID; no subprocess for modeled observations; exit/signal/exception fidelity.
cases.negative_controls: See each named case: omitted handoff/effect, stale token/state, wrong request identity, unknown commands, dropped bootstrap or missing active coverage evidence.

cases.purpose: Hash-checked immutable sources and finite publisher/skill responses; strict missing/extra request accounting.
